name: stripe-payment-to-xero-invoice-paid

trigger.authentication_note: Stripe dennis@work.flowers — the exact connection/version the classic Zap used. NOT the other similarly-named connection in the account ('Stripe dennis@work.flowers #2', StripeCLIAPI@2.25.1) — do not confuse the two on any future edit.
trigger.trigger_note: No filter params — fires on every completed Stripe payment (subscriptions, direct Stripe invoices, one-off charges, Harvest-issued invoices, everything). All the Harvest-specific scoping happens in code (via metadata + description parsing), matching the classic Zap's design. This trigger DOES carry a details.webhook_url (Zapier's own internal subscription mechanism for this trigger type, not an external catch URL).

connections_note: Xero work.flowers, XeroCLIAPI@2.21.0 — same connection every other Xero Zap in this repo uses. Used twice in the workflow body: once to find the invoice, once to record the payment against it. Not bound on the trigger (Stripe is).
version_pinning_note: Newest versions of each direct dependency published at least 24h before build time, per the Vercel sandbox's pnpm minimumReleaseAge=1440 requirement.

tasks_per_run.non_harvest_payment: 0 (skipped in code before any app action — most Stripe payments aren't Harvest invoices)
tasks_per_run.harvest_payment_already_paid: 1 (Xero find-invoice) — idempotency guard fires after the lookup, before any write

money_adjacent_design.note: This workflow WRITES a real payment record to Xero's ledger — reviewed and scoped carefully given the stakes, since the classic Zap had zero validation (never live-tested).
money_adjacent_design.idempotency_guard: If the matched invoice is already Status=PAID or AmountDue<=0, skip cleanly rather than record a duplicate payment. Verified against real data: invoice HAR-13 is already PAID with Payment.Reference exactly matching the Stripe payment intent id pi_3TbFjkJYWXjnDZq80rolzF1Q used in testing.
money_adjacent_design.throw_on_unresolvable: A Harvest-tagged Stripe payment whose description doesn't match 'Charge for Invoice <number>', or whose extracted invoice number doesn't exist in Xero, THROWS (surfaces as a Zapier error alert) rather than silently skipping — deliberate choice (confirmed with Dennis) since a real payment going unrecorded with no trace would be worse than a visible error.
money_adjacent_design.no_currency_or_amount_mismatch_check: Deliberately NOT added (confirmed with Dennis) — the workflow records whatever the invoice's currency/AmountDue implies without cross-checking Stripe's amount, matching the classic Zap's design closely.
money_adjacent_design.amount_scaling_verified: Stripe's amount_received is used AS-IS, no /100 cents conversion — cross-checked against real data: Stripe amount_received=900 (amount_received_formatted 'SGD 900.00') for pi_3TbFjkJYWXjnDZq80rolzF1Q exactly matches the ALREADY-RECORDED Xero Payment.Amount '900.00' on invoice HAR-13. Zapier's Stripe app exposes these fields pre-scaled to the real currency amount, unlike Stripe's raw cents-based REST API.
money_adjacent_design.account_id_verified: Stripe SGD (a7c3277b-8f30-4d25-9aca-8237422b908b) is the ONLY Stripe-related bank/clearing account in the org (confirmed via list-action-input-field-choices across 27 accounts) — used regardless of the invoice's currency (USD Harvest invoices HAR-9/HAR-10 exist and are presumably also settled here), matching the classic Zap's hardcoded mapping. currency_rate is left unset, same as the classic Zap; Xero applies its own day rate for non-base-currency invoices.

invoice_lookup.action: XeroCLIAPI search invoice_v2 (Find Invoice), search_by: Number
invoice_lookup.why: Resolves the Harvest invoice number (e.g. 'HAR-13') to its real InvoiceID before recording the payment, and is what makes the idempotency/already-paid guard possible. The classic Zap never did this lookup — it would have blindly created a payment (or failed) with no idea whether one already existed.

harvest_matching.via_metadata: charge.metadata.via === 'Harvest' (case-insensitive), read off the trigger's nested `charge` object first, falling back to the top-level PaymentIntent metadata (identical in every sample seen — Stripe copies metadata from PaymentIntent to charge).
harvest_matching.invoice_number_extraction: Regex against charge.description / top-level description: '^Charge for Invoice\\s+(.+)$' — verified against 8 real Harvest-tagged payments (HAR-1 through HAR-13), all matching exactly.
harvest_matching.status_guard: Also checks payload status === 'succeeded' when present, at zero cost — the New Payment trigger should only deliver completed payments anyway.

verified_cases.payment: pi_3TbFjkJYWXjnDZq80rolzF1Q, HAR-13, Start Right Pte Ltd, SGD 900.00
verified_cases.result: skipped, reason 'invoice is already fully paid in Xero' (Status PAID). Confirms the idempotency guard against real data — this exact payment is already recorded in Xero.
skipped, reason 'not a Harvest-tagged payment'. Real sample data — most of the 20 sampled payments are subscriptions/direct invoices, not Harvest.
skipped, reason 'no payment intent id in payload'. No Xero call, no throw.

verified_cases.case: Full payment-composition path, dryRun:true, against a real currently-unpaid invoice (INV-0083, not actually a Harvest invoice — used only to exercise the code path safely with no write)
verified_cases.result: outcome 'dry-run'. Correctly resolved InvoiceID, composed payment inputs (date ISO string, amount 1500, reference the synthetic Stripe id, account_id Stripe SGD, invoice_type Invoice). No Xero write made.
THROWS: 'Could not extract an invoice number from Stripe payment pi_bad_desc's description "Something unexpected" (expected "Charge for Invoice <number>")'.

verified_cases.case: Invoice number not found in Xero (synthetic, HAR-99999)
verified_cases.result: THROWS: 'Could not find invoice "HAR-99999" in Xero for Stripe payment pi_no_invoice'.

no_live_write_test: No real Xero payment has been created by this workflow yet — every currently-existing Harvest invoice in the live org (HAR-1, HAR-2, HAR-4, HAR-9, HAR-10, HAR-13; HAR-3/HAR-7 not found, presumably voided/renumbered) is already PAID, so there was no safe real case to exercise the write step against. The first live 'record-payment' will be the next Harvest invoice a client actually pays via Stripe after publish. Watch it.
dry_run_note: A manual run accepts the Stripe payload plus {"dryRun": true} and returns the composed payment without recording it. The Stripe trigger never sets dryRun, so production is unaffected.
description: Stripe payment for a Harvest-issued invoice -> record the payment against the matching sales invoice in Xero (bank account: Stripe SGD). Migration of the classic 'Mark Harvest Invoice Paid in Xero when Stripe Payment Received' Zap.

replaces_classic_zap.title: Mark Harvest Invoice Paid in Xero when Stripe Payment Received
replaces_classic_zap.old_shape: StripeCLIAPI@2.25.2 new_payment (no params) -> FilterAPI 'Harvest Invoice' (charge.metadata.via iexact "Harvest") -> ZapierFormatterCLIAPI@1.0.8 string.replace (strip 'Charge for Invoice ' prefix) -> XeroCLIAPI@2.21.0 write payment (invoice_type Invoice, account_id Stripe SGD, date/amount/reference from the Stripe charge). Four nodes.
replaces_classic_zap.status: The trigger node was NOT paused (still polling), but the filter, formatter and Xero payment nodes were ALL paused: true in the export — so the classic Zap has never actually recorded a payment. Turn the classic Zap off in the Zapier UI rather than unpausing it, or it and this workflow will both attempt to record the same payment.
known_issues_fixed: No idempotency guard at all — the classic Zap would have blindly attempted to create a payment on every matching delivery, with no lookup to check whether one already existed. Now looks up the invoice first and skips if already fully paid.
String replace transform moved from a paid Zapier Formatter step to a free pure-code regex extraction — same intent as the classic Zap, minus the formatter task.

No guard against an empty/test delivery, an unresolvable description, or a nonexistent invoice number — the first now skips cleanly, the latter two now throw loudly instead of silently failing or misbehaving.
deliberately_preserved: The invoice-number extraction logic (strip the 'Charge for Invoice ' prefix).
invoice_type 'Invoice', account_id 'Stripe SGD', amount taken directly from Stripe with no cents conversion, reference set to the Stripe payment/charge id.
No currency or amount mismatch validation against the invoice — confirmed with Dennis to keep this close to the classic Zap's design rather than add extra guards.
